item_short_desc: Rely on strength and durability with the Standard '8' Ring, expertly crafted from 6061-T6 aluminum alloy and hard-coated for enhanced performance. This lightweight yet robust device accommodates ropes up to 5/8 inches and boasts a remarkable breaking strength of 10,000 lbs. NFPA compliant, it’s the perfect choice for climbing, rescue operations, or rigging tasks.
